ex.t: She told me (that) she would be late.
He promised (that) he would come early.
She admitted (that) she had made a mistake.
The company informed staff about the change.
He added that he needed more help.
The mayor announced that a new bridge would be built.
She said she was leaving the next day.
He said he had come back the day before.

explain.ko: 남이 한 말을 전할 때는 보통 시제를 한 단계 과거로 옮깁니다(백시프트): 현재 → 과거, 과거 → 과거완료, will → would, can → could. 대명사와 시간 표현도 바뀝니다: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, now → then. say 뒤에는 목적어가 바로 오지 않고, tell 뒤에는 사람이 옵니다(She told me). 전한 내용이 아직 사실이거나 전달하는 말이 현재면 시제를 바꾸지 않아도 됩니다.
explain.en: To report what someone said we usually move the tense back one step (backshift): present → past, past → past perfect, will → would, can → could. Pronouns and time words change too: tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, now → then. After say there is no person (He said that …); after tell there is one (She told me …). If the statement is still true or the reporting verb is in the present, you don't need to change the tense.

head: 직접 / Direct
간접 / Reported
예문 / Example
rows: 'I'm tired.' → He said he was tired.
'I work here.' → She said she worked there.
'I met him.' → She said she had met him.
'I'll help.' → He said he would help.
the next day / the day before
'I'll go tomorrow.' → She said she'd go the next day.

notes.ko: say 뒤에는 사람을 쓰지 않고(He said that…), tell 뒤에는 사람이 옵니다(He told me that…).
notes.en: Say isn't followed by a person (He said that …); tell is (He told me that …).

notes.ko: that은 생략할 수 있습니다: He said (that) he was tired.
notes.en: 'That' can be left out: He said (that) he was tired.

notes.ko: promise, admit, explain 같은 동사로도 말을 전합니다.
notes.en: Verbs like promise, admit and explain can also report speech.

examples.t: He said, 'I'm tired.' → He said (that) he was tired.

lines.t: Breaking news. At a press conference this morning, the mayor announced that the central library would close next year. He explained that the building was too old and would be too expensive to repair. The mayor added that a new library would be built by 2028.

expressions.t: She told me she would be late.
He said he had already had lunch.
They said they were moving the following week.
He admitted he had made a mistake.

prompt.ko: 친구에게 들은 말을 3문장으로 전해 보세요: 친구가 한 말, 계획에 대해 한 말, 그가 한 약속.
prompt.en: Report 3 things a friend told you: something they said, something about their plans, and a promise they made.

task.model: My friend said she was tired. She told me she was moving the following week. She promised to buy me a coffee if I helped her.

model_trans.ko: 제 친구는 피곤하다고 말했어요. 그녀는 다음 주에 이사한다고 했어요. 그리고 이사를 도와주면 커피를 사겠다고 약속했어요.
model_trans.en: My friend said she was tired. She told me she was moving the following week. She promised to buy me a coffee if I helped her.
